en: The postcard displays a black and white photograph of a stately, three-story residential house with ornate architectural details, a tiled roof, balconies, and arched windows. Leafy trees line the street and vintage cars are parked outside the house, suggesting a mid-20th century setting. The street is placid, and a picket fence marks the property. On the back, there are museum stamps and hand-written cataloguing marks.
